events.content:
Added a notification toggle to the Settings page. The Server Action stores the preference in a cookie, then calls Next.js’s `refresh()` from `next/cache` so the current page shows the updated on/off state without redirecting.

The action is in [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts:1), and the form and preference display are in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1). I also added the required [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx:1).

The production build and TypeScript check passed. I submitted the form in both directions and confirmed each response stayed on the current page with HTTP 200. The preference is stored per browser; there is no account database in this project.
